set.body: Owner decision 2026-09-17: use Scala 3.7.4 uniformly now; frame4s is not a current missing capability and needs no adapter. Update root and isolated consumer compiler pins plus operative requirements/architecture; preserve historical receipts. Fix only compiler migration fallout and verify JVM/Scala.js, CI-style gates and packaged consumer when feasible. No frame4s dependency, adapter or broad API redesign.
set.title: Adopt Scala 3.7.4 without adding frame4s integration
